title: Iron Status of Women and Young Children in the United States
brief_summary: This analysis describes the distribution of TBI and the prevalence of iron deficiency (ID) and iron deficiency anemia (IDA) among toddlers, non-pregnant women, and pregnant women.
raw_criteria:
Included:

* Children ages 12-23 months and Women ages 12-49 years
* Those who completed the MEC

Excluded:

\- Those missing data on iron biomarkers
study_population: NHANES is a nationally-representative, cross-sectional study of nutrition and health for individuals residing in the U.S.
